source: reference points of the normal-presidency attention distribution (Biden spring 2022, GDELT), converted to core-corpus units

anchor.basis: Biden 2022 daily GDELT shares (median 0.78%, p95 2.40%, max 4.13%) x measured core/GDELT scale 1.47

notes: Every share floor is a reference point of the NORM president's own distribution (Biden spring 2022, with the Ukraine war on the front pages, so a conservative norm): puddles = his median day, wet = double his median day, soaked = his p95 day, flooding = his single busiest day of the whole window.
No floor references Trump's own distribution, and no floor was tuned to make any zone rare or common: how often each zone occurs is an empirical outcome, not a design target.
Rank, dominance and breadth floors retained from v0-eyeballed; they compare against other figures on the same day and are externally anchored by construction.
Biden 2023 (median 0.0%) was measured but looks like a GDELT coverage artifact; it is not used for the anchor.

zones.norm_ref: double the norm president's median day
